name: martin27
caption:
38 PICKED BEFORE HIM 🎮🏀 2.2 points a game as a rookie. Then 27 at Milwaukee.

• 2025 draft: we take Alijah Martin at #39, on a two-way deal
• College: Final Four with Florida Atlantic, NCAA champion with Florida in 2025
• 2025-26 with us: 23 games, 2.2 PPG
• At Milwaukee: 27 points, 9-of-11, 6-of-7 from three, a 121-107 win
• In his 9 games this season: 5.8 PPG in 11.1 minutes

One big night or a real rotation guy? 👇

facts.claim: June 25, 2025: Martin selected 39th overall (#39) by Toronto, signed to a two-way contract; led Florida Atlantic to its first Final Four; won the national championship with Florida (NCAA champion 2025); 38 players were picked before him (pick 39 minus 1)
